Cela signifie que chaque service ou département est responsable du suivi des candidatures pour les postes qu'il propose. Un accusé de réception sera envoyé aux candidates et candidats. jobs.title: External Service Employee "Gastronomy & Catering" (m/f/d) Geneva Region
jobs.description: Pacovis is a solid Swiss company, owner-managed, that has believed in the future for 90 years. As a reliable service provider for production and supply processes in the catering and food sector, we are enthusiastic about finding solutions for our clients. A contagious enthusiasm. Perhaps you too? As part of a planned long-term succession, we are seeking your support. As a   External Service Employee "Gastronomy & Catering" (m/f/d) Geneva Region You strengthen our sales team, enrich our company with joy, drive and competence, and live your personal and professional happiness. In this role, you are responsible for the sales area assigned to you and manage it independently. We are explicitly not looking for a classic "representative." You engage with your clients as an equal and are a competent contact, a problem solver and a source of ideas for our clients. This is a role in which you will thrive and for which we grant you the necessary time. Your responsibilities You accompany and advise our clients comprehensively, in the spirit of a committed service provider You prospect with passion, perseverance and negotiation talent You are able to correctly identify clients’ needs, potentials and opportunities and proactively contribute to the development of marketable solutions You tenaciously achieve the jointly defined objectivesYou carry out projects independently, reliably and within deadlines You love our clients and our products Your profile Perseverance, mental flexibility, social skills and a sense of responsibility are among your strengths. You have a complete professional training and several years of professional experience in a managerial position with great personal responsibility as a business leader (or similar) in the gastronomy, catering or food sector. If you are not unfamiliar with the sales sector, you are welcome as a candidate. We will help you change career paths. Your centre of life is located in the Geneva region. Your prospects The challenge ahead is to grow and gain skills through daily tasks in a dynamic environment. You will work closely with the "gastronomy & catering" sales manager as well as with the internal service. We offer you a job with great personal responsibility, good social benefits and the possibility to arrange your working hours flexibly; a company car completes our benefits package. Contact: Are you enthusiastic? If you see this mission as an opportunity and a challenge to take on, then convince us by sending your complete application file with photo, exclusively via Application Form , Human Resources, Pacovis AG, Grabenmattenstrasse 19, 5608 Stetten. Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications sent by e-mail or post, nor those from recruitment agencies.

jobs.title: Senior Inhouse Sales Manager:in Event Catering & Banqueting
jobs.description: Senior Inhouse Sales Manager - Event Catering & Banqueting (m/f/d | 80-100%) Today FC Basel. Tomorrow Zurich Trade Fair. The day after tomorrow a congress and in between an exclusive menu for 1,000 guests at a corporate event. As one of the largest event caterers in Switzerland, Wassermann & Company plans, organises and caters events for clients from sport, culture and business. These include FC Basel, the Swiss Indoors, the Baloise Session, Art Basel and numerous concerts. We operate in the lively environment of event catering at top locations in Basel and Zurich – from the trade fair to the Congress Centre, to the Musical Theatre or Stadtcasino. The Job As Senior Inhouse Sales Manager, you inspire our clients with exceptional catering experiences at the most attractive event and trade fair locations in Basel and Zurich. You advise our clients competently and personally and transform their wishes into successful bookings with your sales talent. You accompany enquiries from individual consultation and offer preparation to successful contract conclusion and then take over the administrative event coordination. In doing so, you work closely with our operational teams and ensure a smooth handover of the events. You maintain existing customer relationships, identify additional sales potential and actively contribute to the success of Wassermann Catering with your initiative and your sense for the needs of our clients. You combine sales strength with organisational talent and enjoy both customer contact and the careful administrative support of your orders. Your Profile Completed training in gastronomy or hotel management, ideally supplemented by further training in sales At least five years of experience in active B2B sales of event, trade fair or catering services Proven sales success and enjoyment of active, personal and telephone sales Strong communication skills, negotiation skills and a confident, convincing manner Experience in administrative event coordination as well as a structured and independent way of working Organisational talent, flexibility and the ability to keep an overview even with several parallel enquiries High quality awareness, sound industry knowledge and passion for gastronomy and events Confident handling of common office applications and digital tools Very good German skills in spoken and written form as well as good English skills What We Offer You Exciting and varied working environment at the most attractive event locations in Basel and Zurich Unique insights behind the scenes of renowned events and sports events Responsibility and scope for design with the opportunity to contribute your own ideas Structured induction and careful introduction to the area of responsibility Professional and personal development opportunities Appreciative corporate culture with short decision-making paths and a personal atmosphere Attractive employee benefits such as discounts for public transport, fuel and via Swibeco as well as catering during work Who We Are Specialist for catering and events throughout Switzerland with a focus on the top locations in Basel and Zurich Hospitality service provider for sport, culture and corporate events Tailor-made event concepts in all sizes with local colour and down-to-earthness as well as internationality and innovation 80 permanent employees look forward to welcoming you! Apply now Please apply with meaningful documents. Any questions? Susanne Gessler - Head of HR will be happy to answer them Phone: +41 61 375 11 63 or by E-mail: jobs@wassermann-company.ch Wassermann & Company AG | St. Jakobs-Str. 395 | 4052 Basel | +41 61 375 11 63
